'''Lisk''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of bipedal predatory reptiles found on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].<ref name="TOR" /> Lisks were warm-blooded and had fibrous, hair-like scales for use as insulation and defense. They had two pairs of large eyes, each operated independently by one hemisphere of the brain. When sleeping, only half of a Lisk's body would sleep at one time.<ref name="Lisk" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lisk species first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].
Jungle Lisk, Swamp Lisk and Rock Lisk are minipets added to the game in [[2013]].
